judged_text: The update test asserts only 'post.cooked.should =~ /new contents/' and never asserts that embed.content_sha1 was updated to the new digest — the very field whose comparison gates the update branch in TopicEmbed.import (lines 30-34). If the update branch stops persisting the new digest (e.g. the 'embed.update_column(:content_sha1, content_sha1)' line is dropped or writes the stale value), this test still passes because cooked matches the new content, while every subsequent feed poll re-enters the revise branch for the same content indefinitely — the test verifies the symptom (cooked text) but not the mechanism (digest persistence) it exists to cover.

adjudication.rationale: In `spec/models/topic_embed_spec.rb`, the "Supports updating the post" example only asserts `post.cooked` includes the new contents and does not verify that `TopicEmbed#content_sha1` is updated. In `app/models/topic_embed.rb`, the update path is gated by `if content_sha1 != embed.content_sha1` and then persists via `embed.update_column(:content_sha1, content_sha1)`. If that persistence were broken, the test would still pass while the system would repeatedly re-enter the revise branch on subsequent polls. This is a specific, diff-grounded test coverage gap, not a demonstrated defect in the implementation shown.
